changelog.message: fixed USB jog wheel reporting and added LED / jog mode controls
changelog.author: Antigravity

changelog.message: synchronized LED state resolution and LEDs State Out port with standalone BmdSpeedEditor op
changelog.author: Antigravity

summary: Interfaces with DaVinci Resolve Speed Editor using WebHID in a popup window.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Activates driver and opens popup window.

ports.name: Open Popup
ports.text: Triggers popup window for WebHID permissions.

ports.name: LEDs State
ports.text: Object dictionary or Array of button LED keys and their active state (e.g. `{"CUT": true, "JOG": false}` or `["CUT", "JOG"]`).

ports.name: Button LEDs
ports.text: Raw bitfield for the buttons LEDs.

ports.name: Jog LEDs
ports.text: Raw bitfield for the jog LEDs (Jog, Shuttle, Scroll).

ports.name: Jog Mode
ports.text: Selects the jog wheel mode (0 = relative ticks, 1 = absolute mode, etc).

ports.name: Device Index
ports.text: Index of the device to connect to if multiple are paired.

ports.name: On Event
ports.text: Fires when any state, key, jog, or battery update arrives.

ports.name: Status
ports.text: Connection status string.

ports.name: Window Status
ports.text: Status of the popup window (Open, Closed, Blocked).

ports.name: Is Connected
ports.text: True if the Speed Editor is connected and authenticated.

ports.name: LEDs State Out
ports.text: Object dictionary containing the resolved boolean state of all 18 button LEDs and 3 jog mode LEDs.

ports.name: Keys Pressed
ports.text: Array of raw key codes currently held down.

ports.name: Key Names
ports.text: Array of friendly names of keys currently held down.

ports.name: Last Key
ports.text: Name of the last key that triggered a press/release action.

ports.name: Last Key Pressed
ports.text: True if the last key event was a press, false if release.

ports.name: Key Event
ports.text: Fires when a key is pressed or released.

ports.name: Jog Value
ports.text: Current position of the jog wheel.

ports.name: Jog Delta
ports.text: Jog movement delta since last tick.

ports.name: Jog Turned
ports.text: Fires when the jog wheel rotates.

ports.name: Battery Level
ports.text: Battery charge level (0-100).

ports.name: Charging
ports.text: True if the device is plugged in and charging.
